title: dejar, decirle que + mood (tell him to…), es esencial que, ojalá

cards.title: dejar = to leave (something)
cards.body: As in leaving a message, not leaving a place (that's salir). Un mensaje = a message.

examples.en: I want you to leave me a message.
examples.es: Quiero que me dejes un mensaje.

cards.title: decir que + mood = tell someone TO do
cards.body: With the mood tense it's an order; without it (deja), it's information: 'that he's leaving me a message'.

examples.en: I want to tell him to leave me a message.
examples.es: Quiero decirle que me deje un mensaje.

examples.en: When he leaves you the message, call me.
examples.es: Cuando te deje el mensaje, llámame.

examples.en: It's essential that he sees my message.
examples.es: Es esencial que vea mi mensaje.

cards.title: ojalá = hopefully / let's hope
cards.body: From Arabic, connected with Allah; one story says it's 'ojo-Allah'. ¡Ojo! = watch out. It's followed by the mood tense.

cards.title: Optional uses: tone and feeling
cards.body: Optional uses of the mood tense can add humour, sarcasm, sincerity or irritation, and they're best explored in real conversation.
